shared_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE richly detailed painted sculpted-metal fantasy race emblem for Kalistar. It is an isolated cutout with a genuinely transparent background, real RGBA PNG alpha outside its silhouette. Square high-resolution canvas. One centered emblem filling about 84% of the longest dimension with safe margins; no clipping.
Art direction derived from the actual old race PNG inspected by the art agent: dimensional polished and worn silver/steel planes, copper or aged-gold edges, deeply carved recesses, rich material colors and sharp painted highlights. It should feel like a beautifully sculpted fantasy relic illustrated by a painter. Broad substantial details and strong silhouette must read at 90 pixels; retain rich relief and craftsmanship. Not a flat ivory logo, vector, origami, decal, outline symbol or plastic toy. Do not reduce it to three shapes.
Only the intrinsic head/organic silhouette. NO backing plate, disk, diamond, shield, ring, square, medallion, frame, wreath, pedestal or floor shadow. The card supplies its own socket. No text, label, watermark or surrounding decoration. Empty space outside the silhouette is actual transparency, not a colored background or transparency-grid illustration.

policy.delivery: native PNG exact copy; no local pixel edits
policy.qa: native inspection and 90px previews on light/dark; alpha and SHA256
policy.reference_strategy: Actual old PNGs are obligatory inspected visual sources. After the first reference-attached RHINOZ call produced RGB checkerboard, use reference-derived text-only built-in generation for genuine alpha; preserve all failed-native provenance and use a targeted regeneration for RHINOZ.
policy.alpha_prompt_tip: User confirmed reference-attached edits can flatten to RGB. Remaining fresh generations start with the user's explicit real-alpha preamble and use no refpaths.
